  • Method Details

    • average

      public static String average(double rating)
      Formats an average rating as text with a leading star glyph.

      Uses the English locale so the decimal separator is always a period.

      Parameters:
      rating - average rating to display
      Returns:
      text such as 4.50 / 5 preceded by a star glyph

    • average

      public static String average(double rating, long count)
      Formats an average rating together with its review count.
      Parameters:
      rating - average rating to display
      count - number of reviews; 1 renders the singular label review, every other value renders reviews
      Returns:
      the text from average(double) followed by the parenthesised count

    • stars

      public static javafx.scene.control.Label stars(int rating)
      Builds a read-only label containing five filled or empty star glyphs.

      The label uses the shared rating style and exposes accessible text such as "4 out of 5 stars".

      Parameters:
      rating - number of filled stars, normally 0 through 5
      Returns:
      a new label showing the requested rating
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if rating is negative or greater than 5

    • buyerName

      public static String buyerName(String username)
      Returns the display name for the buyer who wrote a review.
      Parameters:
      username - buyer username, or null when the account was deleted
      Returns:
      "@username", or "Deleted buyer" when the username is null
